power.answer: MEA's baggage pages blocked our reader (Cloudflare), so this page uses the ICAO rule that took effect on 27 March 2026: at most two power banks per passenger, none recharged during the flight. Check MEA for its watt-hour limit and checked-baggage rule.

faq: How many power banks can I carry on MEA?
The ICAO standard from 27 March 2026 limits passengers to two; MEA's own page could not be read.
Can I recharge a power bank on a MEA flight?
Under the ICAO standard, passengers are prohibited from recharging power banks during flights.
